1. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method of providing a user with access to a resource of a contact center, comprising the steps of: (a) providing a search engine interface to a user's computer system for searching documents on one or more websites; (b) receiving a search query from the user's computer system via said interface; (c) sending a request based on said search query to a computerised system of a contact center __only when the search query indicates a need for direct contact center assistance__; (d) receiving, in response to said request, data enabling a contact center link to be provided to said user, wherein said contact center link, when activated, initiates an interactive communications session between the user and a resource of the contact center __selected based on the content of the search query and predetermined routing rules__; and (e) returning said contact center link to said user as part of a response to said search query __integrated with document search results in a unified response interface__.

2. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, further comprising the steps of conducting a search within said documents on one or more websites in response to said search query, and returning at least one document link to one of said documents as part of said response to said search query __wherein the document search and contact center link provision occur in parallel processing streams__.

3. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 2, further comprising the step of formatting said response to said search query to display a first result set including said document link and a second result set including said contact center link __with visual differentiation between document-based results and contact center resources__.

4. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said data received in step (d) enable a plurality of contact center links to be provided to said user __each corresponding to different contact center resources or skillsets available to handle the user's request__.

5. (Previously presented) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said data received in step (d) comprise said contact center link.

6. (Previously presented) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said data received in step (d) comprise an identifier of a link cached by the search engine.

7. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link is generated uniquely for said user __at the time of response generation__, whereby activation of the link initiates an interactive communications session recognisable by the contact center as relating to said request from said search engine __through embedded session identifiers__.

8. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said request sent to said contact center includes an identifier of said user __and metadata regarding the search query context__, whereby a subsequent interactive communications session between the user and a resource of the contact center arising from initiation of said contact center link enables the contact center to associate said interactive communications session with said request from the search engine __and to retrieve the original search context__.

9. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 8, wherein said identifier of said user is a network address of said user __combined with a session token generated by the search engine__.

10. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link when activated, initiates an interactive communications session between the user and a predetermined agent of the contact center selected in response to said request __based on agent availability and skillset matching to the search query content__.

11. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link when activated, initiates an interactive communications session between the user and a predetermined queue of agents of the contact center selected in response to said request __wherein the queue is determined by analyzing the search query to identify required skillsets__.

12. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said link is configured to initiate a communications session from a compatible communications application, if such application is available on said user's computer __and wherein the search engine system detects available applications prior to link generation__.

13. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 12, wherein said communications application is a voice or video telephony application __integrated with the user's operating system__.

14. (Previously presented) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 12, wherein said communications application is an instant messaging (IM) application.

15. (Previously presented) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 12, wherein said communications application is integrated with a browser employed by the user to access the search engine interface.

17. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said contact center link contains parameters representing customer requirements __derived from analysis of the search query__ which are passed to said contact center within an interactive communications session initiated on activation of said contact center link.

18. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 1, wherein said parameters are indicative of one or more skillset parameters employed by a management system of said contact center __and are determined at the time of link generation based on the search query content__, whereby said communications session may be directly assigned to a skillset based on the parameters.

19. (Cancelled)

20. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented search engine system providing a user with access to a resource of a contact center, comprising: (a) a server for providing a search engine interface to a user's computer system for searching documents on one or more websites and receiving a search query from the user's computer system via said interface; (b) an interface for providing communication with a computerised system of a contact center __configured to transmit requests only when the search query indicates a need for contact center assistance__; (c) a request generator for formulating a request based on said search query for sending to said computerised system of a contact center __and including metadata regarding the search context and user identifier__; (d) a results generator for providing to said user a contact center link based on data received in response to said request, said contact center link being configured such that, when activated, it enables an interactive communications session between the user and a resource of the contact center __selected through routing rules applied by the contact center system__.

21. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method of providing a user with access to a resource of a contact center, comprising the steps of: (a) receiving from a search engine a request based on a search query submitted to the search engine by a user's computer system __wherein the request includes context information derived from the search query__; (b) determining, from said request, the identity of at least one selected resource of the contact center based on stored rules __that correlate search query characteristics to contact center resources and skillsets__; (c) sending to the search engine, in response to said request, data enabling a contact center link to be provided to said user, whereby said contact center link, when activated, will initiate an interactive communications session between the user and said selected resource of the contact center __with the selected resource pre-identified based on the routing rules__; (d) receiving, from said user, a communications session initiation from which said selected resource may be identified __and verified against the pre-identified resource__; and (e) directing said communications session to said selected resource __or to an alternative resource if the pre-identified resource is unavailable__.

22. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, wherein said data comprise an address of said selected resource __and authentication credentials for direct session establishment__, whereby activation of the link enables the user to initiate a communications session directly with said resource.

23. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, wherein said data comprises an identification, for inclusion in a contact center link to be returned to the user, of one or more skillset parameters employed by a management system of said contact center __derived from analysis of the search query__, whereby said communications session may be directly assigned to a skillset based on the parameters.

24. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, wherein said data comprises a unique identifier, for inclusion in a contact center link to be returned to the user, said unique identifier being assigned to said request received from said search engine __and generated by the contact center system__, whereby a later communications session may be associated with said request based on said unique identifier being communicated within said communications session.

25. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 21, further comprising the step, carried out after having received a communications session initiation from the user, of amending the stored rules __to refine the correlation between search query characteristics and contact center resource assignments__.

26. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 25, wherein the amendment of the stored rules confirms an association between the request received from the search engine and the resource identified in a contact center link activated by the user __based on successful session completion__.

27. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented method as claimed in claim 25, wherein the amendment of the stored rules confirms an association between the request received from the search engine and a resource of the contact center which is different from that specified in a contact center link activated by the user but to which the user's communications session is ultimately directed __indicating that the routing rules require adjustment__.

28. (Cancelled)

29. (Currently amended) A computer-implemented contact center system for providing users with access to a resource of a contact center system, comprising (a) an interface for receiving from a search engine a request based on a search query submitted to the search engine by a user's computer system __and containing search context metadata__ and for returning data to the search engine in response to the request; (b) a storage area storing rules for determining, from the request, the identity of at least one selected resource of the contact center based on stored rules __that correlate search query characteristics to contact center resources and skillsets__; and (c) processing means programmed to determine the identity of at least one selected resource of the contact center based on the stored rules and to generate data enabling a contact center link to be provided to the user, whereby the contact center link, when activated, will initiate an interactive communications session between the user and the selected resource of the contact center __with the resource pre-identified through the routing rules__; wherein the processor is operably connected to the interface to receive the request therefrom and to provide the data thereto.
